# Alchemetryx

> We find the process costing your business most, rebuild it so it runs on its own, and stay to prove it worked. Based in London, UK and Pune, India. UK registered company 17199377.

## Services

- [The Diagnostic](https://alchemetryx.com/diagnostic): 2-week workflow audit. We calculate the hours and money lost to manual friction and provide an engineering blueprint for automation.
- [The Build](https://alchemetryx.com/build): 4 to 8 weeks. We rebuild the bottleneck process into an automated system running directly inside your business.
- [The Retainer](https://alchemetryx.com/retainer): Monthly monitoring, SLA guarantees, proactive maintenance, and continuous workflow expansion.

## Verified Proof & Case Studies

- [Care Home Shift Scheduling](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/care-rota): UK residential care provider. Reduced weekly rota management from 14 hours down to 1.5 hours and cut agency callout costs by 64%.
- [Fitosys Coach Workflow Engine](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/fitosys): Internal venture in India. Built zero-commission UPI payment reconciliation and instant WhatsApp client onboarding, eliminating 4 manual hours per client per month.
- [All Proof](https://alchemetryx.com/proof): Index of delivered systems with measured metrics before and after.

## Regional & Regulatory Focus

- [Alchemetryx India](https://alchemetryx.com/india): GST e-Invoicing compliance for Indian businesses crossing the ₹5 Cr aggregate turnover threshold, including 30-day IRP reporting automation.
